answer.summary: Establish a bounded research inquiry into whether any agent-based system explicitly reports memory retention under stable, low-variation input conditions with measurable duration without state decay.
answer.content: The investigation must focus exclusively on Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 for any explicit description of memory retention mechanisms in stable environments. If such mechanisms are described, the longest observed duration without detectable state decay will be identified as a baseline anchor; if not, the scope is limited to observational absence of reported persistence claims under controlled conditions. This ensures all claims remain tied to directly observed, temporally structured data under defined stability parameters.
